ordering_help.what_full_set_means: Both live products are sold as a full custom bowstring set. You pick colors, optional pinstripe, serving color, then enter bow make, bow model, and cam number if your bow uses one.
ordering_help.color_one_two: Color One and Color Two are the main string color choices for the build. Pick two colors from that series list, or match them if you want a solid look.
ordering_help.pinstripe: Pinstripe is optional. Choose NONE if you do not want a pinstripe.
ordering_help.serving: Serving is the wrapped section where the string takes wear (nocking area and related served zones). Choose a serving color from the list on that product.
ordering_help.bow_make_model_cam: Bow make and bow model are required so the set is built to your bow. Cam number matters on many compounds. If you are unsure of the cam, say so when you order or email the shop with a clear photo of the cam and limb pocket area.

honest_rules: Answer only from harvested store facts plus clear ordering guidance.
